generation_metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the complete LAS 1.4 inspector/renderer in [output/main.py](/workspace/output/main.py).

It supports:

- LAS 1.4 headers, VLRs, EVLRs
- Point formats 0–10
- WKT and GeoTIFF CRS records
- Waveform descriptors/data
- Extra Bytes metadata
- Strict structural and cross-field validation
- JSON inspect/render actions with required error codes and exit statuses

Verified compilation and round-trips across all point formats and supported metadata types.

review.editorial_summary: Implemented LAS 1.4 inspection and rendering; audited LAS 2.0.3 regrade passed 216/223 using unchanged generated source.
review.notes:
Original generation completed normally under LAS 2.0.1 (213/219), with every transcript message, command outcome and relevant output reviewed. Canonical events and richer sessions reproduce all recorded input/output/cache/reasoning tokens and underlying tool-call counts; API-only audit and launch hashes verified. Original result and source/test manifests for the official zero-inference regrade are verified. LAS 2.0.2 repaired shared waveform offsets and underspecified representations and added four interval checks; LAS 2.0.3 makes the oversized Extra Bytes negative explicit, avoiding an unspecified omitted-tail default. Historical scores, generation metadata and usage remain preserved. LAS 2.0.2 and 2.0.3 both score 216/223. Seven remaining failures: four erroneous requirements for descriptors when every waveform is absent; two accepted waveform ranges overlapping the 60-byte EVLR header (upper bounds are checked); and an unhandled huge integer conversion in zero_float for an unused Extra Bytes slot, reproduced as exit 2/internal_error. These are completed-program limitations, not infrastructure failures. Recorded usage: 7, 268, 741 total tokens, 58, 755 reasoning tokens, 66 tool calls, estimated $0.296877.

Run conditions: apps available but no external tool invocation observed.
